title: tests/db CI scripts: keep shell tracing off and uv quiet so the database job log shows only pytest output and errors
answers: Why does the database CI job log repeat uv install output and a package list for every test container?
How do I make the tests/db container setup less noisy without hiding pytest failures?
Where is the shell command tracing for the database Docker Compose test containers turned on or off?
When I add a new command to tests/db/entrypoint.sh, should I use set -x or quiet uv flags?
body:
Path: tests/db/entrypoint.sh (container start: uv sync into /opt/venv, optional MSSQL wait, then the test command), tests/db/compose.sh (Compose wrapper that tears down and runs `docker compose --project-directory tests/db`), and tests/db/check_migration.sh (pre-migration/post-migration database upgrade check). These run for every database test container in CI.
Rule: Use `set -e` only, not `set -ex`, in these scripts so commands are not echoed into the CI log. Pass `--quiet` to `uv sync` and to `uv export`/`uv run` in check_migration.sh, and do not add `uv pip list` or similar dependency dumps. Pytest output and error messages must still reach stdout/stderr, so do not redirect them away.
Symptom: The database CI job log repeated uv dependency resolution output, a full installed-package list, and shell command traces (`+ uv sync ...`) for each test container, burying the actual pytest results.
Constraints: This applies to the shell scripts under tests/db only. `set -e` must remain so a failing setup step still fails the job. The `> /dev/null` on the `uv export` line and the `docker compose down ... > /dev/null 2>&1` line discard stdout only or stdout+stderr for that teardown step; do not extend that pattern to pytest or to the setup commands that can fail.
applies: Shell scripts in tests/db that run inside the database CI containers or wrap docker compose for them; not the mlflow application code or the packaged mlflow[db] extra.
says: Automated test logs for database services are flooded with installation output burying errors.
Make continuous integration build logs clean so database test failures are visible immediately.
Verbose dependency installation traces hide actual test failures in database check runs.
Database test execution screens show excessive package resolution details instead of results.
search: Continuous integration scripts in tests/db disable shell command tracing and suppress uv output so job logs display only test output and errors. Scripts tests/db/entrypoint.sh, tests/db/compose.sh, and tests/db/check_migration.sh must use set -e rather than set -ex, pass --quiet to uv sync, uv export, and uv run, and omit package dumps like uv pip list. This guidance applies only to shell scripts in tests/db, requiring pytest output to remain visible on stdout and stderr while preserving set -e for setup failures.
